title: Family estates from Bordeaux to Napa, one shop in Vaughan.
body: Wines and spirits from families we know by name, delivered anywhere in Ontario.
alt: Rows of vines running down a hillside toward a farmhouse

title: Limited allocations, by the case, not the pallet.
body: Pomerol, Pessac-Léognan and Napa Cabernet in small numbers. When they are gone, they are gone until next year.
alt: Old bottles resting on iron racks in a dim cellar

title: Taste it at dinner. Bring the case home.
body: Our wines are poured at 7 Enoteca and Centro on the Square.
alt: Red wine being poured into a glass at a restaurant table

title: Grappa aged in oak, acacia and cherry.
body: Villa de Varda and Bonaventura Maschio: Italy's great distilling families.
alt: Oak barrels stacked in a dim cellar
